details:
* SECURITY UPDATE: stack buffer overflow in NC4_HDF5_inq_attname()
     - debian/patches/CVE-2026-86095.patch: return NC_EMAXNAME when an
       attribute name read from an HDF5 file is longer than NC_MAX_NAME;
       names of up to NC_MAX_NAME characters are returned unchanged
     - CVE-2026-86095
   * Fix a stack buffer over-read in NC4_HDF5_inq_att() on attribute names of
     exactly NC_MAX_NAME characters (not a CVE)
     - debian/patches/hdf5-norm-name-nul-termination.patch: NUL-terminate the
       normalized name returned by nc4_hdf5_find_grp_var_att(), from upstream
       commit 0582c2044a89
   * Size the in-package buffers that receive netCDF object names
     NC_MAX_NAME + 1 bytes, so that a legal 256-character name no longer
     overflows them in nccopy, ncdump, libdap2 and libdispatch (not a CVE)
     - debian/patches/name-buffers-nc-max-name-plus-one.patch: resize the
       char[NC_MAX_NAME] name buffers passed to nc_inq_attname() and the
       other name-returning calls
